name: claude-mem supplied-source SQLite FTS retrieval component

corpus.status: all eligible text-only LoCoMo heldout conversations, already observed regression data

representation: Native SessionStore schema and SessionSearch FTS. Harness bulk INSERT supplies original title/text/project/date, empty subtitle/narrative/facts/concepts. One synthetic parent session per page satisfies foreign keys. Source annotations and answers never enter the backend.
native_entry: Unchanged SessionSearch.searchObservations(original_query, {project, limit:5, orderBy:'relevance'}). Native AND/substring/any-term handling is not replaced.

retrieval.caches: Persistent native process; natural SQLite/process warming; no adapter result cache and no OS-cold-cache claim

assembly.policy: Identical original full pages and citation overhead, rank-order whole blocks; not Book's newer native token API

boundaries: Supplied-source SQLite FTS component only, no observer/Chroma/worker/MCP/timeline/session-injection/final-answer measurement.
Native returned row-array JSON tokens include actual native metadata; not a production MCP payload.
Separate native function/JSON bridge latency, source/runtime preparation, process startup, native schema, supplied page load/FTS, checkpoint, DB/WAL/SHM bytes and RSS.
Compare quality to verified historical shared-page reports, but retain historical timing environment and boundaries; no cross-product full-workflow speed ratio.
durability: Attempt-start and completed query rows are fsynced to a new per-run ledger. Preserve failures and IDs; do not mix interrupted timing runs into a fresh run or silently regenerate an existing output.
validation: Exact dataset, documents and exporter hashes/counts; exact original source and project on every native returned row; all six caps; source stability and native process success.
failure_policy: All first-pass query IDs remain in denominators with empty evidence on a failed call. Any native error, source/scope mismatch or failed gate invalidates performance claims; failed ledger is preserved. No outcome-informed parameter changes.
publication: Reports publish source IDs, hashes, counts and metrics, not copyrighted public source or question text.
